levels.surface: شيخ من أصحابنا يكنى بأبي عبد الله

notes: The compiler's father «أبي ره» is a bare relation.
«شيخ من أصحابنا يكنى بأبي عبد الله» is unnamed: the kunya describes him and is not a name to read (rule 3). «رجل» is unnamed.
The Imam after «عن» is a narrator (rule 2), and the chain ends at him. Diacritics are left out of the surfaces.
